# Nebulex.Adapters.Redis v3.0.0 - Table of Contents

Nebulex adapter for Redis

## Modules

- [Nebulex.Adapters.Redis](https://nebulex-redis-adapter.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.md): Nebulex adapter for Redis. This adapter is implemented using `Redix`
(a Redis driver for Elixir).
- [Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Cluster.Keyslot](https://nebulex-redis-adapter.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Cluster.Keyslot.md): Default keyslot implementation for Redis Cluster hash slot calculation.

- [Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Serializer](https://nebulex-redis-adapter.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Serializer.md): A **Serializer** encodes keys and values sent to Redis,
and decodes keys and values in the command output.
- [Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Serializer.Serializable](https://nebulex-redis-adapter.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Redis.Serializer.Serializable.md): Protocol controlling how a key/value is encoded to a string
and how a string is decoded into an Elixir any().
